reviews.body: Thanks! Left a few minor things to check out @pcbeingused333

review_comments.body: Remove. Unless doing something really wonky, the rationale is in the commit message/tests, not in comments

position = resource.public_send(position_method)
position_key = position.nil? ? [1, index] : [0, position]  # index missing on positioned ties
Merge into a single "within" case; overlaps :146/:198

comments.body:
Thanks @eelcoj, done: the sort key in `adjacency.rb` is now `[0, position, index]`, so entries without a position keep their original order. I added an assertion for the tie case; the suite passes (18/18).

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
